name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=walk, descriptor=step_up); accurately describes the action (animate one walk step north / -1 y). No Ghidra address residue, no domain-ID confusion.
purpose: Play the animated 6-frame walk-step UP (north, -1 y) for runtime_char[char_idx]: face north, slide the sprite up one tile, scroll the battle viewport up when the character is in the top rows and the window can scroll, then commit the new position and run the post-move tile-event check.
logic_summary: Caches runtime char base and saved pos_y; sets sprite facing byte (pSprite_state[1]) to 2 (north). Seeds walk_anim_y_scroll_rows to 6 when view_window_origin_y != 0 else 0. Scroll decision: if (pos_y - origin_y) < 2 AND origin_y != 0, scroll up (scroll_delta_y = -0x720 sub-pixel, scroll_window_flag = -1); else just decrement cursor_screen_y (no scroll). 6-frame slide loop (frame 1..6): tick tutorial-progress-with-sfx, palette cycle anim, set walk_anim_phase (pSprite_state[2]) to frame, tick chapter palette anim, accumulate sub-pixel Y offset and scroll-rows; composite the battle tile map -- at top edge (origin_y==0) at workspace +0x8088 with origin (origin_x,0), otherwise set parallax_scroll_y_rows=0x18, composite at +0x55C8 with origin (origin_x, origin_y-1), then clear it to 0; composite all-char overlay; add scroll_delta_y to blit_offset and blit the workspace rect to VGA (0xA0504); wait one BIOS tick. Finalize: pos_y--, view_window_origin_y += scroll_window_flag, cursor_world_y--, clear walk_anim_phase / sub-pixel offset / scroll-rows, then call fd2_check_tile_event_post_action(cursor_world_x, cursor_world_y, 0).
